lab.notes: Times (delays, DC horizon, outage lengths) are laboratory times multiplied by the time compression (15). airtime_s_per_day: airtime of the transmitted frames per wall-clock day of the run, about 15 times the deployment value, to compare with the 30-s daily limit (frames emulated without coverage or lost were not transmitted). SR_bins: steps of the received bins over the steps of the evaluable bins (G), the definition of tab:metrics. SR_counter: share of the steps of G included in the cumulative count of the last received frame of each boot (each frame carries the counter of the boot in which it was sent, which restarts at zero); SR_cumulative is an alias with the former name. counter_gap_max_h_real: longest interval between two consecutive received frames of one boot, at deployment scale (the counter gives totals over such intervals, not per bin). FZR is counted per bin. S0 sends no bins, so its DC, RR and SR_bins are zero by construction; its FZR_naive and FZR_aware show each frame over the bins it covers, FZR_naive_lastbin shows the steps of each frame in its last bin (presentation of the original system, panel (b) of fig:timeline), SR_increments is the share of the steps of G covered by a received S0 frame and S0_interval_coverage the share of G covered. time_err_med_s, time_err_p95_s and time_err_max_s: median, 95th percentile and maximum of the absolute difference between the reconstructed and the true start of each received bin of G, in wall-clock seconds; the ground truth is on the gateway clock (clock_ref = gateway: node clock fitted to the gateway timestamps of the received frames) or, as a fallback, on the PC clock (clock_ref = pc). time_error: the same statistics pooled over the bins of the table runs and of all runs. downlinks: received by the node after the start of the run (EV,ack lines plus acknowledged confirmed uplinks of S4); downlinks_ttn: cross-check in TTN (down/sent on the acknowledgement port plus confirmed uplinks received), null when it cannot be determined. The table includes strategies S0 to S3 only (Methods); other runs are in excluded_runs.

excluded_runs.reason: strategy not defined in Methods (S0 to S3)

time_error.definition: absolute difference between the reconstructed and the true start of each received bin of G, in wall-clock seconds; quantiles with pandas linear interpolation

sim30.notes: DC_followup: share of the bins of the 30 days received by day 30 (end of follow-up). DC_end: share received by day 33, after 3 further days of continuous coverage that represent the return of the device. DC_1h and DC_24h: share received within 1 h and 24 h of the end of the bin. All metrics refer to the bins generated during the 30 days; delays in hours at deployment scale. SR_counter (SR_cumulative in older files): share of the steps included in the cumulative count of the last received frame of each boot. FZR of S0: each frame shown over the bins it covers. airtime_s_per_day (frames received by the network), airtime_tx_s_per_day (frames transmitted by the node, also without coverage, when available) and downlinks_per_day are means over the 33 simulated days (30 of follow-up plus 3 of return), not the values of a single day.
sim30.quantiles: median, q25 and q75 with pandas linear interpolation, as in sim30_summary.csv
